hero.description: Supporters are the foundation and the engine of the EPEW Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem. Your participation helps transform ideas into successful businesses that create jobs, strengthen families, and build stronger communities.

who.title: Who Is a Supporter?
who.description: A Supporter is someone who believes in entrepreneurs and wants to help transform business ideas into successful businesses. Supporters participate in a structured ecosystem that prepares entrepreneurs, coordinates professional services, supports funding readiness, and strengthens communities.

community.title: Community Participation
community.text: Supporters participate in helping entrepreneurs move from ideas to business development, preparation, and launch.

growth.title: Entrepreneur Growth
growth.text: Your participation supports coaching, structure, professional services, visibility, and responsible business growth.

impact.title: Community Impact
impact.text: Successful businesses can create jobs, strengthen families, and contribute to long-term community development.

whySupport.title: Why Become a Supporter?
whySupport.description: Supporters make entrepreneurship possible. They help create the foundation that allows entrepreneurs to prepare, launch, grow, and create lasting impact.

ideas.title: Help Ideas Become Businesses
ideas.text: Your participation helps entrepreneurs receive the support needed to move from vision to business readiness.

launch.title: Help Businesses Launch
launch.text: Supporters help entrepreneurs access structure, coaching, visibility, and professional preparation.

families.title: Strengthen Families
families.text: When entrepreneurs succeed, families gain opportunities, stability, confidence, and long-term growth.

economic.title: Support Economic Development
economic.text: Strong businesses create jobs, services, opportunity, and local economic activity.

longTerm.title: Build Long-Term Impact
longTerm.text: Supporters help create businesses that can grow beyond launch and continue serving communities.

movement.title: Be Part of a Movement
movement.text: EPEW is building a global entrepreneur development model that communities can adopt to reduce poverty through entrepreneurship.

eligibility.title: Who Can Become a Supporter?
eligibility.description: Anyone who believes in entrepreneurship, community development, and business growth can become a supporter.

entrepreneurs.title: Entrepreneurs
entrepreneurs.text: Entrepreneurs can support other entrepreneurs and help grow the ecosystem.

students.title: Students
students.text: Students can participate in learning entrepreneurship and supporting future business leaders.

workers.title: Workers
workers.text: Workers can participate in helping entrepreneurs create jobs and opportunity.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.text: Coaches can support the ecosystem while guiding entrepreneurs toward readiness.

retired.title: Retired Individuals
retired.text: Retired individuals can use their experience and participation to support entrepreneurs.

anyone.title: Anyone Who Believes
anyone.text: Anyone who believes in entrepreneurship, families, communities, and economic opportunity can become a supporter.

participation.title: How Supporters Participate
participation.description: EPEW follows a structured participation process designed to promote transparency, accountability, entrepreneur preparation, and community impact.

ecosystem.title: Every Entrepreneur Needs a Community Behind Them
ecosystem.paragraph1: Successful businesses are rarely built alone. Every entrepreneur benefits from encouragement, preparation, professional guidance, and a community that believes in their vision.
ecosystem.paragraph2: Founding Supporters make entrepreneurship possible by helping create the environment where businesses can launch, grow, and create lasting community impact.

development.title: Business Development
development.text: Help entrepreneurs organize and strengthen their businesses.

services.title: Professional Services
services.text: Support coordinated services that prepare entrepreneurs for success.

launch.title: Business Launch
launch.text: Help entrepreneurs successfully open their businesses.

growth.title: Community Growth
growth.text: Every successful entrepreneur strengthens the local community.

longTerm.title: Long-Term Success
longTerm.text: Support businesses beyond opening day through continued growth.

impact.title: Your Participation Creates Community Impact
impact.description: Every entrepreneur supported through EPEW has the potential to create jobs, strengthen families, provide valuable services, and contribute to stronger communities and lasting economic growth.

benefits.title: Participation Benefits
benefits.description: Supporters participate in entrepreneur success, community development, and the growth of businesses throughout the EPEW ecosystem.
benefits.rateDescription: Qualified supporters may receive annual participation benefits of up to 6%, subject to program policies and business performance.
benefits.disclaimer: Participation benefits are not guaranteed. They depend on business performance, entrepreneur success, and EPEW program policies.

structured.title: Structured
structured.text: Every entrepreneur follows a clear development process.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.text: Supporters can follow entrepreneur progress throughout the journey.

accountable.title: Accountable
accountable.text: Entrepreneurs provide quarterly reporting and ongoing accountability.

community.title: Community Driven
community.text: Communities become active participants in entrepreneurship.

entrepreneur.title: Entrepreneur Focused
entrepreneur.text: Everything is designed to help entrepreneurs succeed.

vision.title: Long-Term Vision
vision.text: Building businesses that continue creating value for years to come.

cta.title: Become a Founding Supporter Today
cta.description: Your participation helps transform ideas into businesses, businesses into opportunities, and opportunities into stronger communities.
